fingerprint.hook: Motivation title 'THE POWER OF DISCIPLINE' (navy + blue) over a thin-to-muscular mascot pair with a >> arrow
fingerprint.pacing: 8 slides, almost no body text; grid slides carry 6 exercise names each
fingerprint.text_overlay: Headings: Anton-like condensed heavy grotesque, Title Case (ALL CAPS on covers), navy #041732 with accent blue; '#N' numerals in blue, slightly italic; short blue underline (about 12.6% wide) under each heading; body: Didact Gothic-like light sans, gray #4b4945, about 2.7% of frame height, left-aligned at x=10%, 2 to 4 short lines; BLUE BRO logo top-left on every slide; grid cards: numbered dark circle + grey condensed exercise name + '2-3 Sets x 6-8 Reps'
fingerprint.audio: third-party sound (library-style title and author), not original, no voiceover; slideshow so the sound is only background
fingerprint.arc: Motivation → what to eat → what to train each day (with a rest day) → comment-to-DM eBook funnel in the caption
